# Ian Pontorno — Growth Engineer & Marketing Technologist

> Ian Franco Collada Pontorno is a Growth Engineer and Software Developer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
> He combines paid media strategy, marketing automation, analytics, and full-stack software development to scale business growth.

## Who is Ian Pontorno?

Ian Pontorno (full name Ian Franco Collada Pontorno) is a professional who bridges the gap between marketing and engineering.
He designs and implements data-driven growth systems: from optimizing paid advertising campaigns to building custom internal tools and automations that improve business performance.

He currently works at Fanger Design (Buenos Aires, Argentina) as Marketing Engineer, managing paid media across Meta Ads and Google Ads, handling daily digital operations, and developing web solutions. Previously, he worked 6 years at Codere (2019–2025) as IT Operations & Automation Specialist, and as Front-End Developer at Ilummi.

## Core Expertise

- **Growth Engineering**: building systems that connect marketing, data, and software to drive measurable business growth
- **Paid Media Management**: Meta Ads and Google Ads campaign analysis, optimization, and reporting based on client business objectives
- **Marketing Automation**: Python scripts, REST API integrations, and workflow automations to reduce manual effort and improve scalability
- **Full-Stack Web Development**: Next.js, React, TypeScript applications; WordPress and CMS management
- **Data & Analytics**: Power BI dashboards, Excel reporting, ETL pipelines, data engineering, Google Analytics
- **IT Operations**: AWS, Docker, SAP-style workflows, ServiceNow, Jira, enterprise application support

- **The Boyz** — Immersive cinematic web comic reader with panel-by-panel navigation and dynamic dialogue editors. https://theboyz-comic.vercel.app/
